caption: The drawing depicts three views of a round, shallow bowl-like object. The largest view shows the object from an angle above and to the side, displaying its interior surface, which is decorated with a swirling, continuous yellow line design. The interior of the bowl is a rich brown color. To the upper right of the main object, there is a smaller view showing a top-down perspective of the same bowl, highlighting the circular shape and the yellow line decoration that covers most of the interior surface. In the lower left corner, a side-profile view of the bowl is presented, showing its shallow depth and brown coloring. The drawing is composed on an off-white or cream background, and the outlines and shading of the objects suggest depth and curvature.
title: Pie Plate
